title: Fix VIES integrity check: tolerate country-code prefix on echoed VAT number (uptake fix)
summary: The VIES integrity check for VAT numbers now tolerates country-code prefixes in echoed responses, normalizing both sides before comparison to prevent false rejection of valid VAT numbers during registration.
key_points: Fixed regression where VIES responses echoing VAT numbers with country-code prefix were wrongly rejected as mismatches
Normalizes both request and response values to prefix-stripped form before integrity check comparison
Prevents hard block on saving VAT numbers when security checks fail due to cosmetic prefix differences
Preserves security intent by still rejecting genuinely different numbers or country codes
Resolves 10 failing mocks in NAV repository uptake tests that require live VIES mock service
